speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation. I understand you are presenting with fever and abdominal tenderness after childbirth; have you noticed any foul-smelling vaginal discharge or difficulty urinating?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old woman. The patient is in the postpartum period after delivering an 11 pound boy vaginally at 40 weeks gestation. She experienced a prolonged course during labor. She reports increased frequency of urination and uterine tenderness. She also mentions a decrease in bowel sounds.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The prolonged labor and 11-pound baby are significant risk factors. You mentioned uterine tenderness and decreased bowel sounds; have you noticed any deviation of the uterus to one side, or any pain when you press on your abdomen?
